catalyst_rows.indication: macular edema due to retinal inflammation
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Continued progress in the Phase 2 KLARITY study of KIO-104, with an upcoming, pre-defined safety review to support advancement to the next dose level

extractor_notes.blockers: PR discusses ongoing Phase 2 ABACUS-2 (KIO-301) enrollment and a pre-defined safety review for KIO-104 KLARITY but does not give a specific forward-dated catalyst (e.g., interim/topline date). ABACUS-1 Nature Medicine publication is historical (past). Only the dose-escalation safety review milestone is forward-dated but lacks a concrete date.
